text.arabic_uthmani: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن كُلِّ بَابٍۢ

words.gloss_range: plural garden destination specified by the following permanence term
words.root_gloss_range: cultivated garden branch selected; concealment and protective-cover pressure remain as background root texture

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: permanence term completing the garden construct

words.prose: {{ar:جَنَّٰتُ}} ({{tr:jannātu}}) opens as a destination noun before motion begins, turning the prior outcome in 13:22 into an entered scene. Its plural construct form lets many managed, life-sustaining covered garden spaces be identified by {{ar:عَدْنٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿadnin}}), while the wider root range is narrowed to cultivated, protected enclosure rather than unseen beings. The familiar enter-gardens formula is made local by permanence, righteous kin, and the later angelic reception.

topics.headline: destination before action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens by specifying the prior final outcome as a concrete destination before any entry action begins.
topics.reason: The nominative verbless opening and boundary evidence allow the garden phrase to complete the prior outcome from 13:22.

topics.headline: plural construct destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard plural distributes the destination into multiple garden spaces while the construct with the next word supplies its identity.
topics.reason: The local form is plural and construct-bound; the singular reading is useful contrast but does not replace the canonical plural.

topics.headline: covered cultivated refuge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the garden as a protected, covered, life-sustaining enclosure, while the unseen-being branch stays background rather than local sense.
topics.reason: V4 sense evidence selects the cultivated garden noun in the reward frame and only preserves concealment as root pressure.

topics.headline: formula becomes social scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar enter-gardens formula is reshaped here by permanence, righteous kin, and angelic reception.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and echo rows support the formulaic setting, while local syntax supplies the distinct social architecture.

words.gloss_range: genitive permanence term completing the garden construct
words.root_gloss_range: settling and fixed-residence branch selected; embedded value imagery remains secondary
words.prose: {{ar:عَدْنٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿadnin}}) completes the construct, so the opening gardens are defined as an abiding destination before the entry verb arrives. The word behaves like a rare fixed eschatological title, yet its genitive indefinite surface keeps permanence audible as a quality shared across the plural gardens. The settling root lets that permanence feel like emplacement, with the mineral-deposit image adding embedded weight without replacing the abode sense.

topics.headline: permanence defines the gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that permanence is not an afterthought but the genitive quality that defines what kind of gardens these are.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the word as the second term of the construct phrase.

topics.headline: Eden name with descriptive force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fixed destination title still carries descriptive abiding force through its indefinite genitive surface.
topics.reason: The Quranic distribution is formulaic, but the local tanwīn and construct grammar preserve descriptive permanence.

topics.headline: settled embedded abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices permanence as settled emplacement, with the mineral-deposit image adding weight without replacing the abode sense.
topics.reason: The settling branch is locally selected; the mine image survives only as root-family pressure.

topics.headline: rare formulaic tail
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare root functions almost entirely as the stabilizing tail of the garden formula.
topics.reason: Distributional evidence confines the root to the fixed eschatological collocation and local syntax specializes it.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect entry with attached feminine object suffix referring to the gardens
words.root_gloss_range: entry and inward crossing selected; broader interiority derivatives remain supportive texture

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later matching entry verb without the garden-object suffix

words.prose: {{ar:يَدْخُلُونَهَا}} ({{tr:yadkhulūnahā}}) folds the garden object into the verb through the suffix, so the destination remains grammatically present while the prior righteous group crosses into the enclosed promised inside. The active imperfect makes them grammatical agents of vivid entry rather than patients of admission, and the same entry root later returns without the suffix in {{ar:يَدْخُلُونَ}} ({{tr:yadkhulūna}}), reversing the scene toward angelic visitation.

topics.headline: they enter it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garden destination is carried inside the verb by the attached object suffix rather than repeated as a separate noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the object suffix to the opening garden phrase and marks it as direct object.

topics.headline: unfolding entry by prior group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the previous characterized group continuing into a vivid unfolding entry without being renamed.
topics.reason: The imperfect 3mp form carries a discourse subject from 13:22 into the entry scene.

topics.headline: active agency against passive variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the canonical active form presents the enterers as grammatical agents, while the passive reading remains a contrast about admission.
topics.reason: The accepted passive variant tests agency, but the local canonical surface is active.

topics.headline: crossing into the inside
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices entry as a threshold crossing into an enclosed promised inside, while inner-thought and intermingling derivatives remain supporting texture.
topics.reason: The garden object selects concrete entry; broader interiority derivatives color but do not govern the local sense.

topics.headline: first half of entry mirror
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this first entry verb prepares the later reversal: humans enter gardens, then angels enter upon humans.
topics.reason: The same root and form recur at word 15 with a different complement, creating the ayah-internal mirror.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle opening the righteous-kin expansion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative pronoun fused with the connector

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents the entry clause from ending too soon. Fused to {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}), it turns the next relative clause into an attached expansion of who enters; the relatives are coordinated with and included alongside the enterers, not set off as a detached aside.

topics.headline: connector keeps entry open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the human entry clause is kept open for kin inclusion instead of closing after the first entrants.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the relative clause as coordinated with the entering group.

topics.headline: fused connector and relative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the connective and relative pronoun arriving as one attached device for expanding the entrant group.
topics.reason: The written and recited fusion supports local attachment without changing the particle into a separate lexical item.

topics.headline: coordination with accompaniment pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relatives are both coordinated with and included alongside the enterers.
topics.reason: The local syntax supports ordinary coordination, while accompaniment remains compatible with the inclusion scene.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun opening an eligible class among kin

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: soundness condition supplied by the following verb
partitive source frame introducing the kin categories

words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the kin clause as an eligible whoever, not a named person. Its singular grammar lets the following verb stay singular while the meaning can range across multiple relatives, and the phrase waits for {{ar:صَلَحَ}} ({{tr:ṣalaḥa}}) plus {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) to make eligibility a condition joined to a source group.

topics.headline: open eligible whoever
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that kin inclusion is open to whoever meets the condition rather than assigned to a named family member.
topics.reason: The particle is a relative pronoun followed by its predicate, not an interrogative.

topics.headline: singular grammar, plural reach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one compact singular relative form carrying a potentially plural family set.
topics.reason: QAC grammar and the following singular perfect verb support grammatical singularity with broad reference.

topics.headline: condition plus source group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices eligibility as a two-part frame: soundness as condition and the kin list as source domain.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun awaits the verb and then the partitive phrase, so the condition governs the family categories.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect verb of being sound or righteous, governing kin eligibility
words.root_gloss_range: soundness and righteousness selected; causative repair and reciprocal reconciliation remain background branches
words.prose: {{ar:صَلَحَ}} ({{tr:ṣalaḥa}}) states the condition that makes every kin class eligible: established soundness or righteousness, not blood relation alone. The perfect finite verb presents that eligibility as an achieved state beside the more common righteous-deeds formula, and the Form I intransitive shape narrows the root away from causing reform. Repair and reconciliation branches still make the family inclusion feel like restored integrity.

topics.headline: sound state, not repairing action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relatives are included by being sound or righteous, not by performing a separate reforming action in this phrase.
topics.reason: The local Form I intransitive verb lacks an object and is not the causative reform form.

topics.headline: established soundness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices eligibility as an established state before entry, with the quality-pattern reading sharpening that state as inherent.
topics.reason: The perfect verb and accepted vowel-pattern contrast both support state-quality pressure.

topics.headline: integrated relational soundness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices righteousness as integrity within a family-reunion setting, while repair and reconciliation derivatives remain root pressure.
topics.reason: The local verb selects soundness; broader repair and reconciliation branches explain the relational coloring.

topics.headline: criterion gates every kin class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ancestry, spouses, and descendants are not admitted by relation alone; the soundness condition gates the whole list.
topics.reason: The verb precedes the partitive kin sequence, and attachment evidence places all three nouns under the same frame.

topics.headline: finite verb beside common labels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root appearing as a finite condition here rather than the more common righteous-deeds formula.
topics.reason: Distributional rows show the usual root associations, while local grammar has a standalone finite verb.

words.gloss_range: partitive preposition selecting eligible members from the kin categories

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: soundness condition governing the kin selection

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the kin list selective: from among ancestors, spouses, and descendants, the ones governed by {{ar:صَلَحَ}} ({{tr:ṣalaḥa}}) are included. Its single occurrence scopes over the whole triad and sets up the later contrast with the source phrase before every gate.

topics.headline: partitive filter over kin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the family list is filtered from within broader kin groups rather than included wholesale.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the first genitive and projects over the coordinated series.

topics.headline: one operator for three classes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one visible preposition controlling ancestors, spouses, and descendants together.
topics.reason: The preposition is not repeated before each noun, so one scope frame covers the list.

topics.headline: first of two different min functions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this restrictive family filter will later be mirrored by an abundant gate-source phrase.
topics.reason: The later matching particle has a different function, creating correspondence without identical grammar.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural ancestors under the partitive soundness filter
words.root_gloss_range: fatherhood and origin-source selected; refusal-root adjacency remains non-governing lexical pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: partitive preposition filtering the kin term

words.prose: {{ar:ءَابَآئِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ābāʾihim}}) begins the kin triad by reaching backward to ancestors as the source-line of the group. Its broken plural and attached suffix gather many forebears as their ancestors, while the preceding {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) and {{ar:صَلَحَ}} ({{tr:ṣalaḥa}}) keep ancestry filtered by righteousness. The documented root pressure is narrowed to fatherhood and origin, not refusal.

topics.headline: ancestors as backward source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the kin expansion reaching backward into the source-line behind the enterers.
topics.reason: The fatherhood root and list position support ancestors as the past pole of the kin triad.

topics.headline: possessed ancestral multiplicity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices many generations compressed into a possessed broken plural rather than a generic class of fathers.
topics.reason: The plural morphology and attached suffix bind the category to the entering group.

topics.headline: fatherhood over refusal adjacency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices documented root pressure without confusing ancestors with refusal; the local word belongs to fatherhood and origin.
topics.reason: Morphological and lexical evidence support the fatherhood root; refusal remains only a noted adjacency.

topics.headline: first governed kin term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first kin class establishes the possessed and filtered pattern repeated by the next two terms.
topics.reason: The word is the first genitive after the partitive preposition and shares the recurring suffix with the kin triad.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle adding spouses to the same governed kin list
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the spouse category without resetting the grammar. Fused to the spouse term, it makes the second kin class visibly part of the same enumeration, so the filter that selected from ancestors now carries forward into the middle kin term.

topics.headline: spouses under same filter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices spouses added as a parallel kin class under the same partitive and soundness frame.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second noun with the first governed kin term.

topics.headline: attached second list item
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the spouse term visibly fused into the continuing enumeration rather than launched as a new clause.
topics.reason: The proclitic form supports list continuity; its payoff is small but concrete.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural spouses or paired counterparts under the kin filter
words.root_gloss_range: spouse and counterpart branch selected; species and kind senses remain background pairing pressure
words.prose: {{ar:أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ}} ({{tr:azwājihim}}) supplies the present relational middle of the kin triad: their possessed, gender-neutral paired counterparts. The root can speak of kinds and pairs more broadly, but the local family list narrows the payoff to spouses while preserving complementarity. The repeated suffix keeps spouses inside the same righteous family network as the surrounding kin terms.

topics.headline: possessed paired counterparts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices spouses as possessed paired counterparts, not as an unnamed or gender-specified outside group.
topics.reason: The plural noun is gender-neutral in the evidence and is specified by the attached possessive suffix.

topics.headline: pairing taxonomy narrowed to spouses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root logic of complementarity behind the spouse term, while the kin context selects the spouse relation rather than species kinds.
topics.reason: Same-surah pairing evidence is real, but local governance inside the kin list narrows the sense to spouses.

topics.headline: present relational middle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the triad moving from past ancestors to present paired relation and then to future offspring.
topics.reason: The word is bracketed by conjunctions and occupies the middle slot of the kin sequence.

topics.headline: same possessed network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated suffix keeping spouses in the same righteous family network as the surrounding terms.
topics.reason: Form and co-occurrence rows both support spouse inclusion under the same soundness condition.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle adding descendants as the list closure
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the kin list to its final term. Fused to the offspring word, it attaches descendants as the third coordinated class rather than a new scene, keeping them under the same partitive righteousness filter and letting the family arc land on forward continuation.

topics.headline: final kin-list connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the enumeration completing with descendants under the same prior grammar rather than starting a fresh scene.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the final kin noun with the preceding genitives.

topics.headline: attached final list item
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the last kin class visually attached to the ongoing list.
topics.reason: The proclitic form confirms list continuity and has limited but real payoff.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural descendants closing the kin triad
words.prose: {{ar:ذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ}} ({{tr:dhurriyyātihim}}) closes the kin sequence by pointing forward to their descendants, their own propagated line under the earlier soundness filter. The standard plural lets offspring be heard as distributed lines or persons rather than a collective lineage mass, while scatter and created-continuation derivations, plus hamza and kasra sound variants, sharpen the word as a pressure point without dislodging the local descendant sense.

topics.headline: offspring as future line
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the kin expansion reaching forward into descendants, completing the past-present-future family arc.
topics.reason: The term is the final noun in the kin triad and carries offspring or propagated-continuation semantics.

topics.headline: plural descendants against collective reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard plural distributes descendants as lines or individuals, while the singular reading would collectivize lineage.
topics.reason: The canonical surface has the plural ending; the singular reading is a contrast, not the controlling form.

topics.headline: their descendants under the same filter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices descendants as their own propagated line, still governed by the earlier soundness condition.
topics.reason: The attached suffix and genitive coordination keep the word inside the same possessed and filtered network.

topics.headline: ambiguous root and sound variants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the offspring word as a morphological pressure point where scattering, propagation, hamza, and vowel variants sharpen rather than replace the descendant sense.
topics.reason: The root is ambiguous in the evidence, but local kin syntax fixes the referent as descendants.

topics.headline: kin expansion closes before angels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the human expansion ends with future generation immediately before the ayah shifts to angelic reception.
topics.reason: The word is the last noun before the new angelic clause and completes the lineage sequence.

words.gloss_range: resumptive coordinating particle introducing the angelic reception clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from the human kin expansion into a new angelic clause. Fused to the definite angelic subject, it visibly launches the closing beat while linking the scenes without collapsing them: the actor changes, the direction changes, and the entry root is preserved for the closing reception.

topics.headline: pivot to angelic clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a real scene shift: after human and kin entry, a new angelic subject begins a reception clause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the following span as a new verbal clause with explicit subject.

topics.headline: linked but not collapsed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices continuity with the entry scene without making angels another item in the kin list.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates discourse movement while clause structure changes actor and direction.

topics.headline: connector attached to known subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pivot visibly attached to the definite angelic subject at the start of the closing beat.
topics.reason: The proclitic form makes the transition appear at the word boundary itself.

words.gloss_range: definite plural angels as explicit subject of the second entry verb
words.root_gloss_range: concrete angelic-being sense selected; authority and message-bearing etymological pressures remain interpretive background
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ}} ({{tr:al-malāʾikatu}}) starts the closing beat as a definite, known angelic subject, replacing the earlier implicit human subject. Its broken plural shape, with marked hamza and madd, gathers the agents as non-ordinary visitors, and the word brings authorized and message-bearing pressure into the scene. Same-surah power language (13:13; 13:16) becomes concrete actors here, while the local grammar keeps the referent concrete: angels enter upon the people.

topics.headline: definite angels as actors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reception scene has an explicit known angelic class as its subject, replacing the earlier implicit human subject.
topics.reason: The nominative definite plural is parsed as subject of the following plural verb.

topics.headline: authorized message-bearing agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices angelic approach carrying delegated authority and communicative role, while etymological dispute does not change the concrete angel sense.
topics.reason: The local noun denotes angels; m-l-k and l-ʾ-k pressures explain authority and message-bearing without replacing the referent.

topics.headline: marked angelic noun shape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the angels gathered in a marked broken plural rather than as an ordinary regular plural.
topics.reason: The form rows identify broken plural, definiteness, hamza, and madd as part of the word shape.

topics.headline: reversal from entrants to visitors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turning from humans entering gardens to angels entering upon humans.
topics.reason: The new subject opens the third beat and reverses the direction of the earlier entry scene.

topics.headline: power vocabulary becomes actors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices same-surah power vocabulary reappearing as concrete angelic actors in the reward scene.
topics.reason: Contextual and echo rows support the m-l-k field while local syntax keeps the referent angelic.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect entry by angels, taking a prepositional personal complement rather than an object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: entry-upon and visitation selected; intrusive or merely spatial entry branches remain excluded by local complement and gate route

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: personal recipient phrase for the angelic entry

words.prose: {{ar:يَدْخُلُونَ}} ({{tr:yadkhulūna}}) repeats the earlier entry verb but drops the garden-object suffix, so the bare verb makes room for the personal recipient phrase {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}). The canonical active form gives angels grammatical agency, while the passive reading remains a contrast about directed admission. This makes the second entry a purposeful, authorized visitation through gates rather than intrusion, completing the mirror from humans entering gardens to angels entering upon them and setting up the greeting in 13:24.

topics.headline: entry upon persons
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same entry root redirected from entering a place to visiting persons.
topics.reason: The absence of an object suffix and the following prepositional complement select the entry-upon construction.

topics.headline: active angelic agency against passive contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the canonical active form giving angels grammatical agency, while the passive reading marks directed admission as a contrast.
topics.reason: The local surface is active imperfect; the passive variant is valid contrast but does not govern the canonical parse.

topics.headline: bare verb opens complement shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lack of an attached object makes room for the personal recipient phrase.
topics.reason: Word 15 repeats the earlier verb form but omits the object suffix and takes a prepositional complement.

topics.headline: purposive authorized visitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices angelic approach as purposeful and authorized through gates, not invasive entry.
topics.reason: The entry-upon idiom and every-gate route block the intruder branch from becoming local sense.

topics.headline: mirror completed and greeting prepared
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the mirror completed: admitted humans become recipients of angelic approach that prepares the greeting in 13:24.
topics.reason: The repeated root, changed complement, and boundary evidence connect this clause to the next ayah greeting.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus third-person plural suffix marking the recipients of angelic approach
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) makes the righteous assembly the target of the angels entry-upon. The form is directional and dignifying rather than an obligation marker, and its suffix gathers the human entrants and righteous kin before the greeting turns to direct address in 13:24.

topics.headline: pronoun as approach target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the angelic approach routed to the assembled people through one fused preposition-pronoun form.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the phrase the prepositional complement of the angelic entry verb.

topics.headline: directional upon, not burden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices elevated approach without reading the preposition as obligation imposed on them.
topics.reason: The verb construction selects directional entry-upon; obligation is blocked by the local idiom.

topics.headline: gathered assembly into direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the suffix gathering the enterers and righteous kin, then preparing the direct address of 13:24.
topics.reason: Referent evidence ties the suffix to the collective assembly and echo evidence connects it to the next ayah address.

words.gloss_range: source or route preposition introducing the every-gate phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: universal gate phrase governed by the source preposition

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) now marks route or source, not the partitive filter used earlier for kin. After the angels enter upon the people, this second occurrence stays visible as the source operator before {{ar:كُلِّ بَابٍۢ}} ({{tr:kulli bābin}}), opening the scene outward toward every access point.

topics.headline: source route before gates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause adding route and access points after actor and recipient have already been named.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the gate phrase as source or route, not as a partitive kin marker.

topics.headline: operator before universal phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the source operator staying visible before the universal quantifier expands the route.
topics.reason: The preposition scopes over the complete construct phrase, not the quantifier alone.

topics.headline: restrictive min becomes abundant min
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated particle reversing pressure: first it filters people, then it opens access from every gate.
topics.reason: The two occurrences share form but differ in grammar and payoff inside the ayah.

words.gloss_range: genitive universal quantifier governing the singular gate noun
words.root_gloss_range: totality and exhaustive coverage selected; fatigue or depletion branch inactive locally

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: singular gate noun governed by the quantifier
source preposition governing the quantifier phrase

words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) turns the gate phrase into distributive totality: each gate is counted as an access point. Its construct grammar depends on {{ar:بَابٍۢ}} ({{tr:bābin}}), and with the preceding {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) it reverses the earlier selective family filter into abundant reception. The totality branch is local here, not fatigue or depletion, and the same-surah totality vocabulary seen in provision language (13:3) is localized as every-gate access.

topics.headline: each gate individually
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices every gate counted distributively, not a vague mass of gates.
topics.reason: The construct with a singular indefinite complement gives universal distributive force.

topics.headline: quantifier as scope operator
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final phrase built step by step: source preposition, quantifier, then gate noun.
topics.reason: The word is genitive under the preposition and governs the following noun as construct head.

topics.headline: totality branch selected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exhaustive coverage of access points while fatigue or depletion branches remain inactive.
topics.reason: The gate construct requires quantifier totality, blocking the fatigue branch from local activation.

topics.headline: closing expansion into total access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing by widening reception from one route to all routes.
topics.reason: The quantifier combines with the second source preposition and gate noun to reverse earlier restriction into abundance.

topics.headline: same-surah totality localized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the surah totality vocabulary reappearing locally as every-gate access in the reward scene.
topics.reason: Same-surah evidence supports lexical continuity, while local syntax limits it to the gate phrase.

words.gloss_range: singular indefinite gate noun completing the every-gate route phrase
words.root_gloss_range: physical gate or access-channel branch selected; category/chapter sense remains secondary abstraction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: universal quantifier distributing over the gate noun

words.prose: {{ar:بَابٍۢ}} ({{tr:bābin}}) gives the final route phrase its concrete access noun, landing the ayah on access points rather than on the angels themselves. Under {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}), the singular indefinite form makes the movement gate by gate, and the gate is a structured, authorized access channel rather than a mere category label. The familiar gate-entry formula (39:73) is reassigned here to angels entering upon the righteous, so the ayah that began with abiding enclosed gardens closes with totalized access into their reception scene.

topics.headline: ayah closes on access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah landing not on the angels themselves but on the access points through which reception arrives.
topics.reason: The noun completes the final prepositional phrase and occupies the ayah-final position.

topics.headline: singular gate under every
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices each gate individuated under totality rather than all gates collapsed into one mass entrance.
topics.reason: The singular indefinite genitive after the universal quantifier yields distributive force.

topics.headline: controlled access channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the gate as a structured access channel for authorized entry, while category or chapter senses remain secondary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَنَّاتُ ... يَدْخُلُونَهَا ... يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ بَابٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: A vegetation-concealed garden is entered, yet its shelter is not sealed: the doubled entry and totality of gates make controlled permeability part of the dwelling itself.

activation_trace.role: The garden as a place concealed by vegetation supplies the sheltered habitat.
Concealment and being hidden sharpen the habitat as protection rather than mere scenery.
Entry into an inside occurs twice and makes permeability an enacted relation.
Wholeness as complete encompassment distributes the second ingress across the entire threshold system.
A gate as the entrance of a thing supplies the controlled boundary crossed by the angels.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are a closed destination into which the rewarded are placed.
changed_reading.after: The gardens are protective yet deliberately permeable dwellings whose shelter is constituted by ordered entry from every gate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The three relation classes span formative ancestry, paired companionship, and dispersed continuation. Their admission is governed by becoming fitting, while reconciliation remains a live secondary force in the same focus root.

activation_trace.role: Suitability and fittingness supply the condition under which relations belong in the dwelling.
Reconciliation that removes estrangement keeps relational repair live beside individual righteousness.
Fatherhood as generation and upbringing supplies the household's formative line.
A counterpart joined to its pair supplies lateral household attachment.
Gentle dispersed emergence supplies descendants as a line spreading forward through time.

changed_reading.before: Each person receives an individual reward, with righteous relatives appended as companions.
changed_reading.after: Admission reconstitutes a cross-generational household of formative causes, joined counterparts, and dispersed continuations; fit and reconciled relation is part of the reward's shape.

baseline_models.mechanism: The subject shift across the repeated verb creates two nested arrivals: the household crosses into the garden, then angels cross into the household's occupied space. Arrival therefore continues after residence begins.

activation_trace.role: Repeated passage into an inside supplies the two-stage motion of residents and angels.
The interior and intimate inward space make the second entry an approach upon persons, not merely another building entrance.
The explicit angel branch fixes the second moving subject as angels.
Making a thing into multiple doors supplies a distributed network for the second arrival.

changed_reading.before: Entry is a single transfer into paradise followed by static residence.
changed_reading.after: Entry is recursive: humans enter the dwelling, then the dwelling opens into repeated angelic encounter from a distributed set of approaches.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence contrasts a firmly bound covenant and commanded joining with unbinding and severance, places the admitted family at its center, and follows it with peace. This revises familial ṣalaḥ from a merely private qualification toward relation kept, repaired, and made fit for the good home.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation that removes estrangement gives the focus condition a relational mechanism.
Unbinding something firmly constructed supplies the rejected destruction of relation.
A confirmed covenant supplies the binding structure that must be preserved.
Joining one thing to another until it adheres supplies the positive action immediately preceding the family scene.
Peace as reconciliation against conflict supplies the household's voiced outcome.
Severing connection and instituting estrangement supplies the mirrored path to the bad home.

structural_cues: The 13:20-25 sequence runs bound covenant, commanded joining, admitted household, peace, then severed connection and bad home.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding, joining, the focus family list, peace, and mirrored severing; I infer that maintained or repaired relation is one arrow from ṣalaḥ to shared admission. A live alternative is that joining names general ethics while ṣalaḥ here denotes only each relative's individual righteousness.

changed_reading.before: Relatives enter only because each independently passes a moral threshold.
changed_reading.after: Independent righteousness remains live, but the household also enacts the commanded preservation and repair of bonds: reconciled relation belongs inside the good home's architecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pairs of fruit, neighboring gardens, same-origin palms, one irrigation, and measured wombs create a material analogy for the focus household: a shared source sustains differentiated relational branches, which are gathered without losing their distinct forms.

activation_trace.role: Each counterpart joined to a pair supplies differentiation by relation within created fruit.
Intertwining and vigorous plant growth make the garden a living assemblage rather than a neutral container.
Close siblings from one origin supply an explicit botanical image of differentiated kinship.
A share and channel of irrigation supplies one sustaining flow apportioned among distinct growths.
Womb-linked kinship connects biological emergence to the focus lineage list.
A measure by which a thing reaches its limit supplies bounded differentiation rather than undivided sameness.
Gentle dispersed emergence carries the ecological differentiation forward as descendants.

structural_cues: 13:3-4 places fruit pairs, neighboring gardens, same-origin palms, and one water before 13:8's measured wombs and 13:23's spouses and descendants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ecological and birth sequence; I infer an analogy between differentiated growth from shared provision and family branches regathered in the focus garden. A live alternative is that these are independent creation signs with no household-level arrow.

changed_reading.before: The family list is a social entourage added to an otherwise unrelated garden setting.
changed_reading.after: The family and garden can be read as one differentiated living assemblage: shared provision gathers paired and branching life without flattening its distinct relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier successive preservers occupy front and rear; in the focus, angels approach through every gate; immediately after, their approach becomes peace-address. The all-sided circuit shifts from vigilance around vulnerable persons to hospitable access around secured residents.

activation_trace.role: Succession and alternation supply a circulating sequence of preservers.
Guarding and attentive preservation supply the earlier protective function.
The explicit angels supply the agents of the later all-gate approach.
Entry into an inside converts an exterior perimeter into hospitable approach.
The gate as entrance supplies the boundary whose function has shifted from guarding to welcome.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the content of the angelic address.

structural_cues: 13:11 positions preservers before and behind, 13:23 distributes angelic entry across every gate, and 13:24 supplies their direct peace-address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive preservers, guarding, focus angels, all-gate entry, and peace; I infer continuity of protective function and its transformation into welcome. A live alternative is that the earlier preservers are unrelated to the focus angels and only provide a spatial analogy.

changed_reading.before: The angels are ceremonial visitors who arrive after the household is settled.
changed_reading.after: Their gate-by-gate approach completes an all-sided protective pattern: vigilance around vulnerable lives has become safe, intimate welcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later garden's flowing rivers, lasting yield, and lasting shade resolve an apparent tension in the focus: stable residence need not mean stasis. Shelter persists through ongoing flow, provision, and cover.

activation_trace.role: The vegetation-concealed garden repeats the focus habitat and links the later description back to it.
Flow and free coursing supply continuous motion within the stable shelter.
Continuance and permanence make recurring provision structurally stable.
Shade as covering shelter supplies the garden's enduring protection.
Intertwining, vigorous vegetation lets the focus garden carry living renewal rather than inert enclosure.

structural_cues: The un-inventoried focus modifier عَدْنٍ is retained only as a residence-frame; no branch identity is inferred for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, enduring produce, enduring shade, and the focus garden; I infer stability-through-renewal as the arrow connecting them. A live alternative is a simple list of permanent amenities without a process model.

changed_reading.before: Permanent residence suggests an immobile, sealed endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Permanence is dynamically maintained: water courses, provision continues, vegetation renews, and shelter endures while entries remain active.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pairing of messengers with spouses and descendants repeats two-thirds of the focus family list. The focus household can therefore preserve an embodied relational pattern carried through sacred history rather than suspend personhood in isolated reward.

activation_trace.role: Marriage partners assigned to messengers supply historical continuity for the focus spouses.
Gentle emergence and spread supply descendants as an ongoing historical line.
Generation and upbringing extend that embodied pattern backward into ancestry.

structural_cues: 13:38 explicitly assigns spouses and descendants to earlier messengers, repeating the focus vocabulary after the household admission scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated spouse-descendant pairing; I infer that the focus preserves an embodied, historical mode of personhood into the final dwelling. A live alternative is that 13:38 only rebuts an expectation about messengers and does not interpret 13:23.

changed_reading.before: Family accompaniment is an exceptional sentimental addition to essentially solitary salvation.
changed_reading.after: Shared admission preserves a durable embodied pattern already carried by messengers: personhood arrives with generational and marital relations rather than by erasing them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the crown-and-circumference branch beneath the ordinary quantifier كُلّ; it remains anchored in كُلِّ بَابٍ and the gate's frontier branch, but downstream prose should present it only as a spatial secondary image, not as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: A crown and what encircles supply a perimeter wrapped around the residents.
A terminal boundary or frontier distributes openings around that encircling edge.
Crossing into an inside turns the imagined circumference into an active ring of access.

changed_reading.before: Every gate simply means a large number of architectural doors.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the gates form a crowned perimeter: angelic approach saturates the household's whole boundary rather than using one privileged front.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant strength-and-cohesion branch under lexical مَلَائِكَة; it remains valid as a same-root material analogy anchored to the named angels and repeated ingress, but downstream prose must retain 'angels' and qualify cohesion as an exploratory functional resonance, not an etymological gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ بَابٍ

activation_trace.role: Strength and structural cohesion supply an exploratory function for the angelic arrivals.
The literal angel branch contains the activation and prevents replacement of the named agents.
Repeated ingress supplies the motion by which cohesion reaches the newly assembled household.
Each entrance supplies a threshold at which reinforcement enters.

changed_reading.before: The angels are only named visitors who deliver a greeting.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their repeated ingress also images cohesion arriving from every threshold to stabilize the recomposed household.

strongest_changes: The surrounding join/sever mirror revises familial ṣalaḥ toward maintained or repaired bonds without eliminating the individual-righteousness reading.
The garden, one-water, same-origin growth, and measured-womb sequence activates the household as differentiated living kinship rather than an appended entourage.
Successive guarding, all-gate angelic entry, and peace transform a defensive perimeter into intimate welcome, while the later flowing garden makes permanence dynamic rather than static.
summary.what_was_special: The focus combines a concealed garden, doubled entry, three directions of kinship, and total gates. Context repeatedly turns those details into mechanisms of joining, differentiated growth, preservation, and welcome; the crown-perimeter and angelic-cohesion branches remain contained but live surprises.
remaining_uncertainties: The reconciliation branch of ص ل ح may be contextual resonance rather than the direct sense of صَلَحَ.
Continuity between the 13:11 preservers and the focus angels is reader-supplied; spatial analogy remains viable if agent identity is rejected.
The ecological kinship model may reflect thematic sequencing rather than a causal analogy intended by the text.
The crown-perimeter and angelic-cohesion readings are branch-distant and should remain exploratory alongside the ordinary quantifier and angel senses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `ص ل ح/B001` is soundness opposed to corruption and includes making right. Inside parents, spouses, and descendants, and against corruption in 13:25, I infer repaired fitness within a family network. Entry gathers sound relations, not atomized persons.
2. Repeated `يَدْخُلُونَ` carries households into gardens and angels through every gate. I infer that the second ingress ratifies and continually accesses the first; the destination is permeable to welcome though the covenant resisted rupture.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:25's paired severing and corruption confirmed that the `صَلَحَ` here is relational soundness as well as individual merit.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Entry repairs and interleaves a relational network.** `د خ ل / B001` is entering and `د خ ل / B008` is interleaving and inner layers; `ص ل ح / B001` is soundness against corruption, and `ذ ر ر / B004` is gentle spreading emergence. Human entry is followed by the entry of sound parents, spouses, and descendants, then by angelic entry from every door. Nearby 13:20-22 define covenant as maintained joining, 13:25 defines corruption through severance, and 13:28 settles hearts through remembrance. I assign soundness the role of making persons fit for reintegration and repeated entry the role of weaving generations and visitors into one interior. The packet supplies kin layers, repeated entry, and multiple doors; I infer repaired relations -> shared habitation. The reward reads as restored connectedness rather than solitary admission.

2. **Every door distributes welcome across the whole enclosure.** `ب و ب / B001` is an entrance or door, while `ب و ب / B002` is division into categories. The phrase `مِن كُلِّ بَابٍ` multiplies access points after the family categories have been named. I assign the doors the role of turning distinct relational classes into convergent approaches. The packet supplies differentiated entrants and comprehensive doors; I infer multiple valid approaches -> confirmation that no side of the restored household remains closed. The garden becomes a permeable place of reception, the inverse of 13:18's failed refuge.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:25's cutting of commanded links retrospectively exposed why 13:23 names three family layers before opening every door: the scene repairs precisely the network that corruption severs. 13:28's settled hearts added an inward counterpart to shared entry.

baseline.text: Sürekli kalınacak bahçeler; onlar oraya girerler, atalarından, eşlerinden ve soylarından iyi olanlarla birlikte. Melekler de her kapıdan yanlarına girer.

findings.text: Bahçeye giriş, tek tek kişileri toplamakla kalmaz, iyi hale gelmiş aile bağlarını kuşaklar boyunca yeniden ortak bir iç mekanda örer.
Meleklerin her kapıdan girişi, aile katmanlarını ortak iç mekana alan ilk girişi her yönden onaylayan sürekli bir kabuldür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı örtme, duyulardan gizleme ve bir örtünün arkasına saklanma çekirdeğinde kurar; içte saklama ile insanı örten giysi de bu çekirdeğin açık gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca örtme ve gizlenme alanındadır; akıl yitimi, bahçe ve görünmeyen varlık anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalı kapsar ve başka dallara ya da yalnızca belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı anlamları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi duyuların erişiminden çıkaracak biçimde örtmek ya da gizlemek; kişinin bir şeyin arkasına saklanması, bir şeyi içinde saklaması ve insanı örten giysi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey örtülerek ya da gizlenerek duyuların erişiminden çıkarılır.
Bir örtünün arkasına saklanma, bir şeyi içinde saklama ve insanı örten giysi aynı gizleme çekirdeğine dayanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak ekseni, bir şeyi duyusal algıdan örterek gizlemek ve bu örtünün sağladığı saklılık durumudur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin örtülmesini, bir kişinin saklanmasını veya örtü işlevli bir şeyi birlikte temsil eden en geniş karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Örtme işlemini, duyulardan gizlenme sonucunu ve dalın genel kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir öznenin nesneyi görünmez veya algılanamaz duruma getirdiği geçişli kullanımlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Geçişli örtme eylemini ve bunun doğurduğu gizlenme sonucunu eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin bir örtü veya engel aracılığıyla kendini duyulardan sakladığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Örtü aracını ve öznenin kendisini algıdan saklaması anlamını birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: örtmek; gizleyecek bir örtü sağlamak; içinde saklamak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, duyulardan saklanmayı, içte gizlemeyi ve insanı örten giysiyi aynı çekirdekte toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, örtü ve örtme araçlarının genel söz varlığını daha doğrudan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi örtme ve böylece görünmesini engelleme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kurucu sonucu duyusal erişimden gizlenmedir; komşu dal ise genel örtme ve kaplama alanını daha geniş biçimde adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; en yakın sınır karşılaştırmasını genel örtme dalı sağladığı için yalnızca bu ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ستر الشيء عن الحس والاستتار بشيء وإكنان الشيء في الصدر وما يواري من ثوب أو غيره
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الجنون ولا الجنة ولا الجن
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجيم والنون أصل واحد وهو الستر والتستر (maqayis)؛ أصل الجن ستر الشيء عن الحاسة (mufradat)؛ استجن فلان إذا استتر بشيء (ayn;tahdhib)؛ أجننت الشيء في صدري أكننته (sihah)؛ ما علي جنان إلا ما ترى أي ثوب يواريني (sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca gecenin kararıp bir şeyi karanlığıyla örtmesini bildirir; dalın gece karanlığı ile örtme işlemini birlikte tutan çerçevesi buna uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sırf gece, sırf karanlık veya güneşin batması yeterli değildir; karanlığın bir şeyi örtmesi kurucudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalı verir; başka gece sözlerine veya insan topluluğu ve iç dünya anlamlarına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Gecenin kararması ve bir şeyi kendi karanlığıyla örterek görünmez kılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Gece kararır ve karanlığı bir şeyin üzerini örter.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gecenin kararmasını, bu karanlığın nesneleri örtüp görünmez kılmasıyla birlikte anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gece karanlığının bir kişi, yer veya nesneyi kaplayıp görünmez kıldığı bütün yalın kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Geceyi, kararma sürecini ve karanlığın örtücü sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yerin veya nesnenin gece bastığında karanlık içinde görünmez hale geldiği anlatımlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Gecenin bastırmasını ve nesnenin karanlıkla örtülmesini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gecenin koyu karanlığı ve nesneleri örtmesi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda gece karanlığı yalnızca artmaz, aynı zamanda bir şeyin üzerini örter.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gecenin karanlık hale gelmesini örtülen bir nesne şartı olmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gecenin karanlıklaşması ve yoğun karanlık alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu için kararma yeterliyken odak dalda karanlığın bir kişi, yer veya nesneyi örtmesi anlamın kurucu parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün gece, ışık ve aynı kökten gelen dal adayları değerlendirildi; örtme koşulunu en iyi sınayan kararma dalı yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جن الليل على الشيء إذا أظلم وستره بسواده
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس سواد الناس ولا الجنان بمعنى القلب

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bahçeyi ağaçları veya hurmalıkları toprağı örten ağaçlı bir yer olarak tanımlar; dalın ağaç örtüsünü merkeze alan çerçevesi kaynağa uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her çevrili alan veya her ekili toprak bu dala girmez; ağaçlı bahçe ve ağaçların örttüğü zemin esastır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ağaçlı bahçe anlamını taşır ve ölüm sonrası ödül yurdu ya da genel bitki örtüsü anlamını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Ağaçları, özellikle de sık ağaç veya hurmalıkları zemini örten bahçe ya da koruluk niteliğindeki yerdir.

facets.statement: Ağaçlı bahçenin zemini ağaçların oluşturduğu örtü altında kalır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı bahçe, ağaçlı bahçe ve hurmalık çevresinde birleştirir; ayırt edici özellik ağaçların zemini örtmesidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ağaçların veya hurmalıkların yoğunluğu sayesinde zemini örtülen bahçe ve koruluklar için tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bahçe türünü, ağaç varlığını ve zeminin bu ağaçlarla örtülmesi koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam zeminin ağaçlarla örtülü olduğunu zaten gösterdiğinde doğal ve kısa bir çeviridir.

error_profile.preserves: Ağaçlarla kaplı bahçe referansını bağlam desteğiyle eksiksiz korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: zemini ağaçlarla örtülü bahçe veya koruluk

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bahçeyi ağaçların zemini örtmesiyle tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bahçeyi çevresindeki duvar, engel veya yükseltiyle tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da ağaç veya bitki içeren sınırlı bir bahçe alanına gönderimde bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta içteki ağaç örtüsü, komşuda ise alanı dıştan kuşatan sınır belirleyicidir; bu yüzden sıradan bağlamda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün bahçe, hurmalık, bitki ve aynı kökten dal adayları değerlendirildi; dış sınır ile ağaç örtüsü karşıtlığı en yararlı ayrımdır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجنة بمعنى البستان والحديقة ذات الشجر والنخل الساتر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الجنة الأخروية ولا الجنون
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجنة البستان (maqayis;sihah)؛ الجنة الحديقة وهي بستان ذات شجر ونزهة (ayn)؛ العرب تسمي النخيل جنة (sihah)؛ كل بستان ذي شجر يستر بأشجاره الأرض (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Müslümanların ölümden sonra ulaşacağı ödül yurdunu ve bugün onlardan gizli olan nimetlerini bildirir; dünyevi bahçe benzetmesi yalnızca adlandırma açıklamasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ölüm sonrası ödül yurduyla sınırlıdır; dünyadaki ağaçlı bahçe veya görünmeyen varlıklar topluluğu değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ölüm sonrası ödül yurdu anlamını korur ve dünyadaki bahçe anlamını bu dala katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Müslümanların ölümden sonra ulaşacağı, ödülü ve nimetleri bugün onlardan gizli olan yurttur.

facets.statement: Müslümanların ölümden sonra varacağı ödül yurdunun nimetleri bugün kendilerinden gizlidir.
Adlandırma ya dünyadaki ağaçlı bahçeye benzetilmekte ya da nimetlerin şimdilik gizli oluşuyla açıklanmaktadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ölüm sonrası ödül yurdunda birleşir; adın gerekçesini ağaçlı bahçe benzetmesi veya nimetlerin bugün gizli olmasıyla açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Müslümanların ölümden sonra ulaşacağı ödül yurdundan ve henüz görünmeyen nimetlerinden söz edilen bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ölüm sonrası yurdu, ödül niteliğini, ilgili topluluğu ve nimetlerin şimdiki gizliliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nimetlerin henüz görünmediği bilgisi bağlamdan anlaşıldığında akıcı bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ölüm sonrası varış yerini ve ödül olma niteliğini bağlam desteğiyle korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ölüm sonrası ödül ve gizli nimetler yurdu

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ölüm sonrası ulaşılan ödül yurdunu ve bugün gizli olan nimetleri bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal dünyadaki, zemini ağaçlarla örtülü somut bir bahçeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Adlandırma, ödül yurdunu ağaçlı bahçe imgesiyle ilişkilendirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri ölüm sonrası ve inanç alanına ait bir varış yeridir, diğeri dünyadaki ağaçlı bir alandır; benzetme referansları özdeş kılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dış adaylar bitki adlarıyla sınırlı kaldığından en açıklayıcı karşılaştırma aynı kökün dünyevi bahçe dalıdır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس البستان الدنيوي ولا جماعة الجن

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan gözünden gizli ruhani varlıkları, onların tekil ve topluluk adlarını ve bu varlıkların çok bulunduğu yer için kullanılan bağımlı söz öbeğini birlikte verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yılan adı ve akıl yitimi bu dalın dışında kalır; yer anlamı yalnızca çokluk bildiren belirli söz öbeğine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın varlık ve topluluk anlamları, bu varlıkların çok bulunduğu yeri bildiren söz öbeğine bağlı kullanımdan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların duyularından gizli kabul edilen ruhani varlıklar ve onların topluluğudur. Bu varlıklardan çok bulunan yer anlamı yalnızca ilgili yer söz öbeğine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Ruhani varlıklar insan gözünden ve duyularından gizlidir; ad hem türü hem topluluğunu karşılayabilir.
Tekil biçim bu varlıkların atasını veya bir bireyini, başka biçimler ise topluluğunu bildirir.
Bu varlıkların çok bulunduğu yer anlamı yalın değildir ve belirli bir yer söz öbeğiyle sınırlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insan duyularından gizli ruhani varlıklar çekirdeğinde birleşir; birey, ata, topluluk ve çok bulundukları yer için ayrı biçimler verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın biçimlerin gizli ruhani varlık türünü veya bu türün topluluğunu bildirdiği genel bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Varlık türünü, duyulardan gizliliği ve topluluk kapsamını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz konusu türün tek bir bireyi veya atası anlatıldığında tekil bağlama uyar.

error_profile.preserves: Birey olmayı, ruhani niteliği ve insan duyularından gizli oluşu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca kanıtta verilen yer söz öbeğinin çokluk bildiren bağımlı kullanımında geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Yer referansını, varlıkların çokluğunu ve kullanımın söz öbeğine bağlılığını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: görünmeyen varlıkların atası veya bir bireyi
görünmeyen ruhani varlıkların çok bulunduğu yer

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bu alandaki ayrı bir topluluğu, alt türü veya onlara bağlanan köpekleri bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: görünmeyen varlıklar ve bir alt topluluk
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insan gözünden gizli kabul edilen ruhani varlıklar alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak genel tür ve topluluk adıdır; komşu ise aynı alandaki ayrı bir sınıf veya ona bağlı varlıkları bildirir, bu yüzden ikame edilemez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün varlık, canlı, yer ve aynı kökten adaylar değerlendirildi; genel tür ile ayrı alt topluluk arasındaki sınır en yararlı ayrımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aklın örtülmesini, benlik ile akıl arasına engel girmesini, kişinin bu duruma düşmesini veya düşürülmesini bildirir; görünüşte bu hali takınma da ayrı bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek ya da gösterilen akıl yitimiyle sınırlıdır; görünmeyen varlıklar ve ağaçlı bahçe anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın akıl yitimi dalını kapsar ve başka dalların varlık ya da yer anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Aklın işleyişini örten veya benlik ile akıl arasına engel koyan akıl yitimi durumudur; kişi bu duruma düşebilir, düşürülebilir ya da böyleymiş gibi davranabilir.

facets.statement: Akıl yitimi, aklın örtülmesi veya benlik ile akıl arasına engel girmesi olarak kavranır.
Kişinin aklını yitirmesi ile bir etkenin onu bu duruma getirmesi katılımcıları farklı iki süreçtir.
Gerçek durumdan ayrı olarak kişi kendisini aklını yitirmiş gibi gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar akıl işleyişinin örtülmesi ve kişinin aklını yitirmesi çekirdeğinde birleşir; ettirgen süreç ile görünüşte bu hali takınmayı da kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin akıl işleyişini kaybettiği veya aklı ile benliği arasına engel girdiği genel durumlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Akıl yitimini ve bunun aklı örten bir engel olarak kavranmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin gerçek bir akıl yitimi durumuna girdiği geçişsiz kullanımlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin akıl işleyişini kaybetmesini ve durum değişimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin gerçek durumu değil, bu durumun görünüşünü isteyerek sergilediği bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Akıl yitimini gerçek yaşamadan onun görünüşünü sergileme ayrımını korur.
